description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractEntityPlaceholder' within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides common functionality for entity ID placeholders, including supported names, support checks, and resolution logic based on entity ID fields.

classes.name: AbstractEntityPlaceholder
classes.description: An abstract base class for entity ID placeholders that implements common logic for handling entity identifiers with support for names, namespaces, and IDs.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns the list of placeholder names supported by this placeholder.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a given placeholder name is supported.

methods.name: doResolve
methods.description: Resolves the placeholder value from the entity ID if it's not a dummy.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the placeholder.
